last_attempts_log.asr_text: So, would that experience help the AI the next time it was called on? The researchers compared 13 AIs that had experience on the island with 13 AIs that had the same setup, but no such experience. On a new island, the challenge was to build as many towers as possible, each five blocks high, in one hour. When the researchers looked at whether the AIs could build more than two, the experienced group did better. The ones that had taken a detour were now one step ahead.

One tip in the strategy notes was not something to overlook.
